papers.title_en: FutureWorld: A Plug-and-Play Causal Next-State Predictor for Interactive Video World Exploration
papers.authors: Guangyuan Li, Kelu Yao, Shuolin Xu, Xinlei Yu, Wei Xing, Lei Zhao, Peng-Tao Jiang, Xiaogang Xu, Xiaobin Hu
papers.evidence: 保持场景一致性的交互式视频世界模型
papers.tldr: 交互式视频世界模型需在长时交互中保持场景一致，但基于历史潜变量的复用会循环传播模糊细节、几何失真与语义漂移。为此，作者提出即插即用的因果下一块预测器 C-NCP，在生成下一视频块前从当前潜变量与动作预测未来场景状态，并以其引导生成。将 C-NCP 接入四个基础生成器并在三个基准评测，结果显示误差累积降低、长时一致性提升。该工作为抑制历史误差回流提供了可跨模型迁移的预测引导方案。
papers.abstract_en: Interactive video world models aim to follow user actions while maintaining scene consistency over extended interactions. History-based methods reuse generated latents to preserve scene content, but three limitations of this reuse contribute to error recirculation. 1) The latent generated at each interaction is retained as history, potentially containing blurred details, geometric distortions, or semantic drift. 2) Although retrieved historical content matches the current scene, it can still contain errors that are carried into the next chunk. 3) New outputs then become history for later interactions, potentially reinforcing the same errors through repeated reuse. To limit this cycle, we aim to predict the future scene state from the current generated latent and the next action before generating the next interaction's video chunk. This future-state prior provides guidance for the next chunk, with the aim of reducing the errors carried forward from history. To this end, we propose a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) with cross-model adaptability and prediction-guided modulation. We integrate C-NCP into four base generators and evaluate the augmented models across three benchmarks for interactive long-video generation and action-conditioned world modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate reduced error accumulation and improved long-horizon consistency across diverse generation settings. The project page is at https://GuangYuanKK.github.io/futureworld.
